description: Use row bins and exact shared-curve cancellation in combined binary weave rendering; preserve individual paths for boundary gradients.

microbenchmark.method: Fixed geometry, 128/256/400 pixels, 24/48 samples per cubic, original and perturbed controls including endpoints, both phases. Every complete mask must equal the previous renderer. Individual path segments, bins and exclusion queries must also match. Three policy-order rotations after warmup. Each policy repeats all four inputs in batches of at least 16 ms to overcome coarse browser clocks; timings are normalized to one batch of four inputs, with actual durations and repetition counts recorded. Index construction and allocation are included; fixture loading and comparison are excluded. Saved fits never initialize an optimizer.
microbenchmark.qualification: Renderer timings only, three rotated orders after warmup and normalized batches of at least 16 ms. The initial four-input measurements were superseded because WebKit rounded some batches to zero. Optional saved fits are used only to render fixed geometry. Full solver timing is separate.

freshHunodan.criteria: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately.

freshFreeBorder.method: Fresh automatic mask solves. Frames fixed before fitting. Checker strategy replaces the band; weighted strategy retains the original mask with zero band weights. Exported controls are independently rendered with resvg. Geometric and paper checks remain enabled. Variants swap both colours, translate by one source pixel in both axes with background fill, or alter only zero-weight pixels; the protected frame stays fixed.

productionBrowsers.method: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.

qualification: Fresh solves obey existing release quality/geometry/paper gates; faster checks may allow different checkpoints under wall-clock limits. Fresh timing comparisons are not a randomized end-to-end A/B experiment. No claim that renderer speedup equals solver speedup.
